1.why: Clean sans-serif typeface with clear character and line spacing is used throughout.

2.why: Text avoids heavy formatting such as italics or all-caps across all screens.

3.why: Layouts depict a full desktop view rather than a responsive mobile layout.

4.why: Instructions use short sentences and simple plain language.

5.why: Placeholder text illustrates expected input patterns for phone numbers and codes.

6.why: Information is presented concisely without lengthy text blocks.

7.why: Dedicated copy buttons for recovery codes or secret keys are missing.

8.why: Setup secrets are shown only as text without a QR code option.

9.why: Standard form fields exist, but full password manager integration cannot be confirmed visually.

10.why: Primary actions are prominently highlighted with colored call-to-action buttons.

11.why: Screens present a single main workflow task at a time.

12.why: System status messages clearly update the user on progress after submitting.

13.why: Form re-submission is permitted, though explicit code show/hide options are absent.

14.why: Error messages remain polite and non-blaming, but offer generic guidance.

15.why: No visible timers or time constraints are imposed during code entry.
